title: Согласовать документацию, support/security/versioning и migration/recovery guidance
summary: Сделать repository/package documentation исполняемым и правдивым представлением принятого API, guarantees, support envelope, migrations and private publication identity.
why: Текущие README описывают P0/`2026-08`, содержат historical phase labels, а repository lacks top-level security, support and changelog carriers; correct code with stale docs is not a production-grade candidate. `RAG:✅` publication/versioning constraints в `@plan/knowledge/research-P10-design-rag.json`.

include: Root and package READMEs; install/configuration and minimal safe-flow examples; supported PHP/Dart/spec matrix; exact guarantees/non-guarantees; security reporting and vulnerability-handling policy for the current private distribution; support lifecycle; changelog/release notes; PHP/Dart API and upgrading docs; SQL deployment, backup, rollback/forward-recovery and token/key/revocation runbooks; MCP applicability wording; doc source/evidence manifest and executable snippet checker.
exclude: New API or runtime behavior; changing `LICENSE`; selecting public registries/vendor/publisher; public support SLA; converting `publish_to: none`; resolving the Dart MCP path dependency; publication; editing generated receipts.

reads.why: Source input; exact context is preserved in item sections.

rules: Generate the doc/evidence manifest from exact public claims and fail on undocumented or unproved additions. Examples import only supported APIs and name required durable adapters/capabilities; in-memory/testkit paths are explicitly non-production. State exactly “official MCP scenario compatibility” with the applicable boundary. Current identity remains proprietary/private and Dart `publish_to: none`; a public installation or registry URL is forbidden until D5/G-RELEASE. Security/support docs must distinguish supported versions, response path and non-SLA limits without inventing an owner contact. SQL guidance is forward-safe, requires backup/rehearsal and never claims an unproved universal down migration. Public docs contain no P-item IDs, internal reference consumers or confidential plan paths.
guidance: Extract fenced snippets into disposable fixtures and map each to package/runtime prerequisites. Keep one canonical support/version table and generate equality checks for manifests/docs. Add a closed forbidden-claim lexicon for certification, exactly-once, universal rollback and hosted-attestation overclaims. Render plan evidence separately from user-facing docs.
deliverables: Truthful root/package documentation, security/support/versioning policy, migration/operations/recovery guides, executable doc examples and digest-qualified documentation receipt.

result.notes:
Root/package docs 2026-09; SECURITY/SUPPORT/CHANGELOG; docs_gate P10-docs GREEN.
write-site: pre_mutation: allow · pre_final: allow
